chapterInfo.content:
13
Abram ne Lot di ntetemu
1Na Abram ne ne yere ne deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa, ne Lot nso, firii Misraim baa Negeb. 2#Mmb 10.12 Na Abram anya ne ho sɛ, mmoa, dwetɛ ne sika mu. 3Na ɔdii atutena firi Negeb kɔduruu Betel, deɛ akane na ne ntomadan sie no, wɔ Betel ne Ai ntam, 4#Gye 12.8 deɛ afɔrebukyia a ɔsii kane no wɔ. Na Abram sɔree AWURADE wɔ hɔ.
5Na Lot nso a ɔne Abram nam no wɔ nnwan ne anantwie ne ntomadan. 6Na asase no nso mma wɔn sɛ wɔbɛtena faako, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn ahodeɛ dɔɔso sɛ, enti wɔantumi antena faako.
7Na akasakasa baa Abram mmoahwɛfoɔ ne Lot mmoahwɛfoɔ ntam. Na berɛ no mu na Kanaanfoɔ ne Perisifoɔ tete asase no so. 8#Dwom 133.1 Na Abram ka kyerɛɛ Lot sɛ: Mesrɛ wo, mma akasakasa mmma me ne wo ntam, ne me mmoahwɛfoɔ ne wo mmoahwɛfoɔ ntam, na yɛyɛ anuanom. 9Ɛnyɛ asase no nyinaa na ɛda w’anim yi? Mesrɛ wo, twe wo ho firi me ho, sɛ wofa benkum a, mɛfa nifa, na sɛ wofa nifa a, mɛfa benkum.
10Na Lot maa n’ani so hwɛɛ Yordan kanko nyinaa de kɔsi Soar hunuu sɛ ne nyinaa so wɔ nsuo te sɛ AWURADE turo no, te sɛ Misraim, ansa na AWURADE resɛe Sodom ne Gomora no. 11Na Lot yii Yordan kanko no nyinaa, na ɔtu faa apueeɛ fam; na anuanom no dii mpaapaemu. 12Abram tenaa Kanaan asase so, na Lot deɛ, ɔtenaa Yordan kanko no nkuro mu, na ɔtutuu ne ntomadan ara de kɔduruu Sodom. 13#Gye 18.20; 19.4-9 Nso na Sodomfoɔ yɛ atirimuɔdenfoɔ ne nnebɔneyɛfoɔ kɛse, AWURADE anim.
Abram kɔtena Hebron
14Na Lot tee ne ho firii Abram ho no, AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Abram sɛ: Ma w’ani so, na firi deɛ wowɔ hɔ hwɛ atifi fam ne anafoɔ fam, apueeɛ ne atɔeɛ. 15#Gye 12.7 Na asase a wohunu yi nyinaa, wo ne w’asefoɔ na mede bɛma mo daa. 16#Gye 28.14; Num 23.10 Na mɛma w’asefoɔ adɔɔso sɛ asase so mfuturo. Na sɛ obi tumi kan asase so mfuturo a, ɛnneɛ na ɔbɛtumi akan w’asefoɔ nso. 17Sɔre, fa asase no tentene ne ne tɛtrɛtɛ mu, na wo na mede bɛma woɔ.
18 # Gye 14.13, 24 Na Abram tutuu ne ntomadan, na ɔbɛtenaa Mamre pɔ a ɛwɔ Hebron no ho, na ɔsii afɔrebukyia maa AWURADE wɔ hɔ.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na Abram ne ne yere ne deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa, ne Lot nso, firii Misraim baa Negeb. Na Abram anya ne ho sɛ, mmoa, dwetɛ ne sika mu. Na ɔdii atutena firi Negeb kɔduruu Betel, deɛ akane na ne ntomadan sie no, wɔ Betel ne Ai ntam, deɛ afɔrebukyia a ɔsii kane no wɔ. Na Abram sɔree AWURADE wɔ hɔ.
Na Lot nso a ɔne Abram nam no wɔ nnwan ne anantwie ne ntomadan. Na asase no nso mma wɔn sɛ wɔbɛtena faako, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn ahodeɛ dɔɔso sɛ, enti wɔantumi antena faako.
Na akasakasa baa Abram mmoahwɛfoɔ ne Lot mmoahwɛfoɔ ntam. Na berɛ no mu na Kanaanfoɔ ne Perisifoɔ tete asase no so. Na Abram ka kyerɛɛ Lot sɛ: Mesrɛ wo, mma akasakasa mmma me ne wo ntam, ne me mmoahwɛfoɔ ne wo mmoahwɛfoɔ ntam, na yɛyɛ anuanom. Ɛnyɛ asase no nyinaa na ɛda w’anim yi? Mesrɛ wo, twe wo ho firi me ho, sɛ wofa benkum a, mɛfa nifa, na sɛ wofa nifa a, mɛfa benkum.
Na Lot maa n’ani so hwɛɛ Yordan kanko nyinaa de kɔsi Soar hunuu sɛ ne nyinaa so wɔ nsuo te sɛ AWURADE turo no, te sɛ Misraim, ansa na AWURADE resɛe Sodom ne Gomora no. Na Lot yii Yordan kanko no nyinaa, na ɔtu faa apueeɛ fam; na anuanom no dii mpaapaemu. Abram tenaa Kanaan asase so, na Lot deɛ, ɔtenaa Yordan kanko no nkuro mu, na ɔtutuu ne ntomadan ara de kɔduruu Sodom. Nso na Sodomfoɔ yɛ atirimuɔdenfoɔ ne nnebɔneyɛfoɔ kɛse, AWURADE anim.

Na Lot tee ne ho firii Abram ho no, AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Abram sɛ: Ma w’ani so, na firi deɛ wowɔ hɔ hwɛ atifi fam ne anafoɔ fam, apueeɛ ne atɔeɛ. Na asase a wohunu yi nyinaa, wo ne w’asefoɔ na mede bɛma mo daa. Na mɛma w’asefoɔ adɔɔso sɛ asase so mfuturo. Na sɛ obi tumi kan asase so mfuturo a, ɛnneɛ na ɔbɛtumi akan w’asefoɔ nso. Sɔre, fa asase no tentene ne ne tɛtrɛtɛ mu, na wo na mede bɛma woɔ.
Na Abram tutuu ne ntomadan, na ɔbɛtenaa Mamre pɔ a ɛwɔ Hebron no ho, na ɔsii afɔrebukyia maa AWURADE wɔ hɔ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
